item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"verdict":"revise","scores":{"causal_coherence":3,"internal_numeric_consistency":3,"lexical_diversity":1,"domain_plausibility":2,"template_artifact_control":1},"major_pathologies":["Exact duplicate rate is 0.5301, far above the 0.20 gate, with distractors repeatedly copied across reports using predictable node and observation-number substitutions.","Several causal chains combine weakly connected failures without establishing necessity, timing, or state transitions; the transformer and automation fixtures are especially overpacked with independent faults.","In synthetic_s07_r02, a 600 A pickup is described as mismatched against an 850 A minimum fault level even though that pickup should detect such a fault; lowering it to 500 A does not resolve the stated logic.","Synthetic_s02_r02 shifts from ambient temperature above 42°C to a later asserted 45°C without supplying the missing measurement, while other fixtures omit durations needed to reconcile electrical quantities.","Some protection terminology and behavior are implausible or underspecified: device number 52 is treated as a relay, a relief valve is said to disconnect a transformer, and a single breaker pole opening is presented as fully disconnecting a substation.","Impact claims such as exact life reduction, availability degradation, and thermal damage are stated with unsupported precision.","Role labels occasionally misclassify restoration actions as mitigation and causal conclusions as impacts, while headings, captions, and table units contain prose that does not fit those unit types.","The repeated four-cause/four-trigger/four-response/four-impact/four-mitigation structure, formulaic negation sentences, evenly spaced page placement, and recurring corrective-action phrasing expose generator templates."],"mutation_amendment":"Generate each fixture from an explicit timestamped state-transition model, then independently recompute thresholds, currents, energy, and device actions; limit each incident to one primary cause plus at most two contributing conditions, vary section and sentence structure, create topic-specific distractors instead of numbered boilerplate, and reject samples with device-function errors, unsupported precision, role/unit mismatches, or repeated n-grams across reports.","limitations":["This is a blind review of the supplied fictional excerpts and aggregate diagnostics, not validation against real incident records.","Only sampled distractors and semantic-core units were available; omitted document content could alter local coherence judgments.","The scores are qualitative audit ratings, not human validation or evidence of external realism."]}
